description: `False` as a `multipleOf` divisor reached through the same unrecognized-key `$ref`: `bool` is an `int` subtype in Python, so `5 % False` is ordinary arithmetic, raising `ZeroDivisionError` from a genuine zero divisor rather than `TypeError` -- the same text an ordinary `multipleOf: 0` schema would raise. A non-retryable, generic failure, never `schema_invalid`; `on_error: continue` lets the run finish.
